channel.title: Evangelical Times Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: Standing firm when the world shifts under your feet
item.description: The world is changing fast. Ideas that once seemed solid are crumbling. But Scripture doesn’t call us to blend in, it calls us to stand firm.

item.title: Reflections… on worship
item.description: In October 1976 when I was a 20-year-old student at Reading University, I fell on my knees, repented of my sins, and believed on Jesus Christ as my Lord and Saviour.

item.title: Digging again the wells of Christian biography: Banner of Truth video series brings Covenanters to a new audience
item.description: Christian biography ought to be a source of strength and renewal to the believer – a sparkling well of faith-fortifying refreshment. Since its foundation, the Banner of Truth Trust has set great store on Christian history and biography.

item.title: Restless Devotion
item.description: The subtitle of this book is ‘An Urgent Call to Godward Discontentment’. Thompson begins by stating that God commands us as Christians to be contented (as opposed to covetous) in the path to spiritual progress.

item.title: Assisted suicide bill looks likely to falter in Lords due to large number of amendments
item.description: A highly controversial bill to legalise assisted suicide looks like it may die in the House of Lords, as there will not be enough time to debate and vote on all the amendments that have been tabled.

item.title: Bid to ban Bible group at university freshers’ fair thwarted
item.description: An online booking agency has reversed its policy of blocking a Bible ministry from attending university freshers’ fairs. The booking agency, called Native, handles bookings for several university freshers’ fairs, which are events to welcome new students to university life.

item.title: Australia: Teen who saved family points to God for strength
item.description: Australian 13-year-old Austin Appelbee kayaked alone, then swam 4km in open water, then ran 2km to find help after his mother and younger siblings became stranded off the Australian coast.

item.title: Westminster Conference calls evangelicals to bear ‘unashamed witness’
item.description: Last December, the Westminster Conference met for the second year running at the comfortable venue of St Giles Christian Mission in Highbury. Pastor Brad Franklin and his team were welcoming and attentive to the needs of approximately 80 attendees.

item.title: Divine intimacy
item.description: In John 14:10-11, Jesus makes a staggering statement. The Father dwells in the Son, but also, at one and the same time, the Son dwells in the Father. More than this, the Spirit too is in both the Father and the Son as they are within him.

item.title: Ada R. Habershon: A hidden gem
item.description: Here is an example of the way the Lord uses his people to bring about his purposes.
